lead_raw_text:
The structure of CeMgNi is tetragonal, space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 6-atom unit cell and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers with 16 geometric neighbors (8 Mg, 8 Ni), while Mg and Ni each have 10 neighbors, with Ni surrounded by 4 Ce and 6 Mg. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Ni 10-vertex polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Ce 16-vertex polyhedra.
